0c1e924baae3ecbc5fa96e88a1afd0d7d55e8b97.summary: Aqua Team Nautilus analysed eight malicious container images in the Docker Hub account hildeteamtnt, which the report says TeamTNT used. The images carried cryptominers, Tsunami and Mirai, backdoors and Docker escape tools, and at least two were used in attacks. The report calls it a still-active campaign against cloud native environments and misconfigured Docker API ports, and says the newer images use more defence evasion. Published 2020-08-25.

0ce1eae63e681b49a35d3d50bcf5b34100b0272f.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that North Korean actors Diamond Sleet and Onyx Sleet have exploited the TeamCity remote-code execution flaw CVE-2023-42793 since early October 2023. Diamond Sleet uses the ForestTiger backdoor and DLL search-order hijacking loaders (RollSling, FeedLoad) and dumps credentials. Onyx Sleet creates a privileged account, runs system discovery and deploys the HazyLoad proxy tool. Microsoft assesses the actors may be opportunistically compromising vulnerable servers. JetBrains has released an update and a mitigation.
